text:
Alex Chen: Quick sync — need to hand off telemetry sample assets to Datadog SI for the marketplace tile demo. Can we confirm what assets they need? traces, metrics, dashboards, sample app? @Jamie Patel @Maria Gomez

Jamie Patel: Plan: deliver curated dashboards + a small trace load generator + OTLP collector config. Target: Wed next week. Doable? :calendar:

Maria Gomez: Yep. Two quick constraints: dashboard JSONs should be <= 2MB each (Datadog UI quirks), and OTLP will use the grpc receiver in the reference setup. I'll prepare the collector config snippet and strip unused panels.

Maria Gomez: ```receivers:
  otlp:
    protocols:
      grpc:
        endpoint: 0.0.0.0:4317
exporters:
  datadog:
    api_key: <REDACTED>
service:
  pipelines:
    traces:
      receivers: [otlp]
      exporters: [datadog]```

Samir Iqbal: We'll also need a README for the SI: runbook steps, expected queries, and a smoke-test dashboard. I'll add a scripted smoke test that emits traces + metrics. Where should we upload the artifacts?

Alex Chen: Use internal bucket: https://redwood-internal.storage/sample-assets/telemetry-v1. I'll create subfolders dashboards/, traces/, smoke-tests/. Anyone object to that structure?

Jamie Patel: :thumbsup: No objections. Maria, can you reduce JSON sizes and strip unused panels so dashboards render quickly in the demo?

Maria Gomez: On it. Also flag for the runbook: Datadog tile QA looks for a sample_host tag. I'll add a sample span attribute `host.service: sample-app` and include that in the smoke test generator.

dd-bot: Datadog CI: initial validation of dashboards passed (4/5 checks). Failing item: panel size limit on 'gpu-costs' dashboard — panel count/objects exceed recommended size.

Maria Gomez: Will trim 'gpu-costs' panels and reupload today. ETA 4pm PT.

Samir Iqbal: I'll run the smoke test against the updated dashboards after you upload and post the results here (latency, traces/sec, metric cardinality).

Alex Chen: Great — plan: Maria upload by 4pm, Samir run smoke tests, Jamie to coordinate the handoff email to Datadog SI with a short checklist, and I'll draft a concise release note for internal channels. :rocket:
